# Method GetName

#### GetName(PdmObjectId)

Gets the name of an object.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
string GetName(PdmObjectId inObjectId)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  PdmObjectId |  inObjectId |  Object identifier.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  string |  Object name.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
